0.0: What is it?\r\n#b#L0#Have you heard of a ghost tree?#l
0.1: You must have heard the story from cowards. There's no such thing as a ghost tree. I've been training myself for a long time around the rocks, trees and mountains in #m102000000#. I have never seen or heard about it for long.\r\n#b#L0#Ah, is that true?#l
0.2: The North Rocky Mountains have recently been under attack, and it's been bothering me...
